2018.title: Founded at Fairmont Nile City
2018.desc: Premier Health Clinic was established in 2018 in the Fairmont area, Nile City — a comprehensive healthcare center equipped with the highest capabilities and the finest health supplies, from intravenous nutrients to derma services such as Botox, fillers, and other cosmetic and basic services.

2020.title: Expansion Across Cairo & Giza
2020.desc: The clinic expanded by opening several branches within Cairo and Giza, including Arkan Plaza in Sheikh Zayed and EDNC Sodic in the Fifth Settlement — bringing the Premier experience closer to more clients.

2023.title: International Expansion into UAE
2023.desc: Following its success, Premier Health expanded internationally to the United Arab Emirates. The clinic grew into a multi-disciplinary healthcare destination, offering a wide range of advanced services including IV therapy, cosmetic dermatology, aestheticians, and nurses.
